description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art head, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: put the same crown on both heads, sitting on top of the head above the ears: a ring cut from the rim of an orange pumpkin with five pointed tips, three small carved pumpkin faces in it showing warm yellow, a short green stem and a curl of vine at the front, and two short black candles standing in it with small solid teal-green flame shapes (seen from behind, the back of the ring and the candles). Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The head, the face and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
